2125785458349084886.en_summary: For investors convinced 2026 is 2018: 2018 Nasdaq 100 total return 0%, S&P 500 -4%. Questions if it makes sense to be so bearish. Notes 2018 lacked AI secular growth story, EPS estimates and ISM falling all year; only growth was Apple iPhone X. Thinks investors too bearish now, minority view, points to 2019 chart. (Quoted: This is getting absurd... $NVDA is now cheaper than it was at $1.)
2125785458349084886.zh_summary: 對於認為 2026 年是 2018 年的投資者：2018 年納斯達克 100 總回報 0%，標普 500 -4%。質疑現在如此看淡是否合理。指出 2018 年缺乏 AI 長期增長故事，EPS 估計與 ISM 全年下滑；唯一增長是蘋果 iPhone X。認為投資者現在太看淡，屬少數觀點，指向 2019 年圖表。（引用：這越來越荒謬……$NVDA 現在比 $1 時更便宜。）

2125785001597997467.en_summary: Stats: $VIX will be up 3 months in a row. Last time up 4 months was Dec 2019-Mar 2020. $SPX will be down 3 months in a row. Last time down 4+ months was May-Sept 2011. Gambler's fallacy or history as guide? You decide.
2125785001597997467.zh_summary: 統計：$VIX 將連續上漲 3 個月。上次連續上漲 4 個月是 2019 年 12 月至 2020 年 3 月。$SPX 將連續下跌 3 個月。上次連續下跌 4 個月以上是 2011 年 5 月至 9 月。賭徒謬誤還是歷史指引？你決定。
